// This fixture declares a PropertyType constant whose value is a literal the
// walk cannot unquote: an integer. go/parser reports it as a BasicLit like
// any string, so the literal test above it passes and only strconv.Unquote
// separates the two.
//
// It is the shape an author reaches for when adding a constant to a table
// that has grown a numeric neighbour, and a compiler would refuse it — so,
// like names_without_values.go.txt, internal/graph cannot hold it and nothing
// but a fixture can drive it.
package graph

// PropertyType is the type whose constants the walk collects.
type PropertyType string

const TypeNumeric PropertyType = 42
